text: I live in the country of Clouds, and my home is in the bosom of Rainbow. I have brothers, who are Spirits of the Storm, and Sisters, who are Spirits of the gentle Shower; but I am the mildest of them all, and delight to bathe the earth in pleasant dew.

text: In the green valleys, and by the glad sunshine. I leap up from the sea, and shake my wet locks in the air, and men see me, and call me a spirit of the waters. I dwell in the caves of the green valleys, and men shake their heads and say, "Lo, a spirit of the waters!"

name: Cattle robber who loves horses
text: I live where all live, and die where all die; I am nursed on the same plains that give milk to all babies, and I am buried in the dust of the general flock.

name: Cattle robber who loves horses
text: It is a year which will cost the owners of horses some trouble, and the desirers of them some sorrow; it will increase the grief of the unhappy, and diminish the happiness of the prosperous; it will add to the sorrows of the unfortunate, and take from the pleasures of the happy; it will increase the difficulties of the bad, and render the good more perfect.

name: Horse attached to a thousand-cattle bell-rope
text: On the same side of the baronial quarter-circle, which is called a horse-shoe, and which is connected with the bell-rope of a thousand head of cattle. The motion of the remotest sheep is on my flanks, and the motion of the chimney of the fireplace is also on my flank.

name: Horse attached to a thousand-cattle bell-rope
text: It is a year of great events, and a year of great afflictions. The winter was a hard winter, and the spring was a bad spring, and the summer was a dry summer, and the autumn was a melancholy autumn.

name: Ten men, a five-legged horse, and twelve passengers
text: I live in sport, and have five pleasant enemies, whom I must not offend. They are, honey, milk, corn, salt, and pleasant air.
